# Appraisal San Diego

> Private, certified residential real estate appraisals anywhere in San Diego County, California, by Brian Ward (California Certified Residential Real Estate Appraiser since 2004, 7,000+ appraisals). Sister site of https://www.brianward.com/. Phone (619) 717-6588. Email contact@appraisal-sandiego.com.

## Appraisal types
- [Date-of-Death Appraisal](https://www.appraisal-sandiego.com/appraisal-types/date-of-death/): A retrospective value of an inherited home, pinned to the day the owner died, giving heirs and their CPA a stepped-up basis they can support.
- [Estate and Trust Appraisal](https://www.appraisal-sandiego.com/appraisal-types/estate-trust/): Appraisals for trust administration and estate settlement that help trustees value assets, split property fairly among beneficiaries and document their decisions for the accounting.
- [Divorce Appraisal](https://www.appraisal-sandiego.com/appraisal-types/divorce/): An independent appraisal of the marital home or rental for a California divorce, valued as of the date your attorney or the court specifies.
- [Bankruptcy Appraisal](https://www.appraisal-sandiego.com/appraisal-types/bankruptcy/): An appraisal of your San Diego County home as of the petition date, used to support schedules, homestead exemption math and Chapter 13 plan payments.
- [Property Tax Appeal Appraisal](https://www.appraisal-sandiego.com/appraisal-types/tax-appeal/): A lien-date appraisal that shows the market value of your San Diego County home as of January 1, for a decline-in-value review or formal assessment appeal.
- [Family Transfer Appraisal](https://www.appraisal-sandiego.com/appraisal-types/family-transfer/): An appraisal for a home passing between family members by gift, sale or inheritance, supporting gift tax returns, Prop 19 exclusion math and fair pricing.
- [Pre-Listing Appraisal](https://www.appraisal-sandiego.com/appraisal-types/pre-listing/): An independent appraisal before you list, so you can set a realistic price, weigh repairs and evaluate agent opinions with real numbers in hand.
- [Pre-Purchase Appraisal](https://www.appraisal-sandiego.com/appraisal-types/pre-purchase/): An appraisal for buyers who want an independent market value before or during escrow, especially for cash, family, off-market or unusual purchases.
- [Insurance Claim Appraisal](https://www.appraisal-sandiego.com/appraisal-types/insurance-claim/): A market value appraisal for insurance disputes and property damage claims, documenting value before and after a loss or the lasting diminished value.
- [Bail Bond Property Appraisal](https://www.appraisal-sandiego.com/appraisal-types/bail-bond/): An appraisal of a San Diego County home pledged as bail collateral, showing market value so equity can be measured against the bond amount.
- [Immigration I-864 Appraisal](https://www.appraisal-sandiego.com/appraisal-types/immigration-i864/): An appraisal of a sponsor's or joint sponsor's real estate, documenting market value so net equity can count toward the I-864 Affidavit of Support asset requirement.
- [Expert Witness Appraisal](https://www.appraisal-sandiego.com/appraisal-types/expert-witness/): Appraisals, appraisal reviews and expert testimony for real estate disputes heard in San Diego County courts and in mediation or arbitration, retrospective values included.
